Recorded claim:
Durable Try monitor state lives under `~/.tb-tools/try-monitor/` with atomic writes and locks. Import old history as `imported: true`, `phase: "paused"`, `nextCheckAt: null`; scheduled checks only fetch status, and `attempt.assessment` or `attempt.assessmentError` prevents repeat AI use. Detailed `fixup! <parent subject>` messages include causes, changes, validation, limits, and Try history. [Task 6]
